ITEM_BUGGY_KEY_DESC: Summons the buggy it belongs to beside you, or stows it away.
ITEM_BANDAGE_DESC: A roll of gauze. Stops the bleeding and restores a little health.
ITEM_OINTMENT_DESC: Apply for Regen — heals over time.
ITEM_FIRST_AID_KIT_DESC: A full kit. Restores a lot of health.
ITEM_APPLE_DESC: Crisp and a little juicy. Some food, some water.
ITEM_ENERGY_BAR_DESC: Dense and sweet. Keeps hunger at bay.
ITEM_ONIGIRI_DESC: A rice ball wrapped in seaweed. A proper bite.
ITEM_SNACK_DESC: A bag of crisps. More air than food.
ITEM_RAW_MEAT_DESC: Edible in a pinch. Better cooked.
ITEM_COOKED_MEAT_DESC: A hearty meal — fills you up and heals a little.
ITEM_CANNED_TUNA_DESC: Tuna in oil. Food with a little water.
ITEM_SERVICE_PISTOL_DESC: The regular army's sidearm. Chambers pistol ammo.
ITEM_SERVICE_ASSAULT_RIFLE_DESC: The regular army's rifle. Fast fire from a deep magazine. Chambers rifle ammo.
ITEM_SERVICE_SNIPER_RIFLE_DESC: A bolt-action marksman's rifle. Slow, hard-hitting and armor-piercing. Chambers sniper ammo.
ITEM_LIGHT_MACHINE_GUN_DESC: A belt-fed machine gun: a long belt at a fast cyclic rate, heavy to carry. Chambers rifle ammo.
ITEM_TACTICAL_HEADPHONES_DESC: Issue hearing protection with a radio link.
ITEM_PISTOL_AMMO_DESC: Light rounds for the service pistol.
ITEM_RIFLE_AMMO_DESC: Intermediate rounds for the assault rifle.
ITEM_SNIPER_AMMO_DESC: Heavy full-power rounds for the sniper rifle.
ITEM_HE_GRENADE_DESC: An issue high-explosive grenade. All blast.
ITEM_FRAG_GRENADE_DESC: An issue fragmentation grenade. Shrapnel in every direction.
ITEM_ROUND_GLASSES_DESC: Wire-rimmed spectacles from before the collapse.
ITEM_BEANIE_DESC: A knit wool cap with a pom-pom. Keeps the ears warm.
ITEM_WORK_GLOVES_DESC: Padded leather gloves with knit cuffs. Saves the knuckles.
ITEM_SHIRT_DESC: A blue chambray work shirt. Every button still on.
ITEM_PANTS_DESC: Belted khaki cargo pants. The pockets are empty.
ITEM_JUNGLE_HAT_DESC: A wide-brimmed boonie hat that keeps the sun off.
ITEM_FEDORA_DESC: A felt hat with a pinched crown. Older than the colony.
ITEM_HELMET_DESC: A steel combat helmet. Dented, but it still holds.
ITEM_BODY_ARMOR_DESC: A plate carrier with three magazine pouches. Heavy.
ITEM_DUSTER_DESC: A long dust coat, cut for riding out the storms.
ITEM_WORK_BOOTS_DESC: Steel-toed leather boots on a thick sole.
ITEM_BACKPACK_DESC: A leather rucksack with a side pocket. More room to carry.
ITEM_SPANNER_DESC: An open-ended wrench. Turns bolts and heads alike.
ITEM_IRON_PIPE_DESC: A length of pipe. Better than bare hands.
ITEM_IRON_AXE_DESC: A forged iron head on a wooden haft. Fells trees and worse.
ITEM_IRON_PICKAXE_DESC: A pointed iron head for breaking rock and hard ground.
ITEM_BLUEPRINT_DESC: A drawing of some machine nobody builds anymore.
ITEM_VINYL_DESC: Music from before the collapse, if you can find a player.
ITEM_FLOPPY_DISK_DESC: Old data on old media. Someone might still read it.
ITEM_SUPPLY_CRATE_DESC: Sealed tight. Open it to see what's inside.
